actions.action: Silverman 离开后，Renata 直接躺回床上不再起身，连洗澡都不想了（Silverman 全章仅这句出现，身份未交代）。

anchors.anchor: After Silverman left, I got into bed and stayed there.

actions.action: François 的男友 Leon 来电（Renata 任它进留言机），用沙哑耳语说自己过得不好，随后哭起来；Renata 本已被自己的愧疚占满，还要迎面接住他的愧疚。

anchors.anchor: Then he started to cry.
his voice was a hoarse whisper

actions.action: Renata 去 Leon 的地下室公寓（门没锁），见他摊在没铺的床垫上，四周一圈酒杯，唱片机就在旁边。

anchors.anchor: I found him sprawled on his unmade floor mattress
where the door was left unlocked

actions.action: Leon 讲两人如何相遇：1978 年第一次见面、他十七岁且比 François 高一英尺、Paradise Garage 刚开；四年后拿到 Friday membership 在舞池重逢，那首歌响起，他亲吻手指指向天空喊 Larry Levan。

anchors.anchor: The first time we met, it was 1978
The Paradise Garage had just opened.
Four years go by, and I got a Friday membership.
Larry LEVAN!

actions.action: Leon 抖出 François 的婚史：不到十八岁就结了婚，为的是逃出家门。

anchors.anchor: Barely eighteen.
He did it to get out of the house.

actions.action: Renata 说出与 Mark 的第一次：1973 年春在墨西哥、Mark 的车后座；Mark 一见她脱衣便说要把手埋进她的阴毛，像俄国王妃用貂皮手筒暖手。

anchors.anchor: The first time I had sex with Mark, we were in Mexico
Spring of ’73.
In the back of Mark’s car.

actions.action: 在（应为 Mark 祈祷的）场合，Renata 于 Mark 母亲背后低声咒骂：你有罪，他临终喊了你而你没来，你会后悔一辈子；Leon 闻言只说她真狠、干得好。

anchors.anchor: Guilty bitch, he called out for you
How ruthless. Good for you.

actions.action: Leon 请 Renata 当他的告解神父、坦白自己「庆幸一切已经结束」；Renata 说她不信忏悔但愿意听，随后又说这告解不够劲。

anchors.anchor: I need to confess something
I don’t believe in confession
I said, taking his hand.
he said, muffled.
I’m glad it’s over.

turning_point.text: 本章转折点：Leon 把 Renata 当告解神父、坦白「I’m glad it’s over.」，而真正握着秘密的是 Renata——她能见到死去的 François、想告诉 Leon 却不敢开口；她最终意识到 François 需要倾诉的人也许不是自己。

anchors.anchor: Maybe it wasn’t me who François needed to talk to.
who François needed to talk to
I wished, again, that I could tell Leon about it.
Ghost François was one note.

relationships.text: Leon 打了数周长途电话找她；François 住院最后一个晚上，Leon 把话筒贴到他耳边，他闭上眼；Leon 认为该有话说的是她。

anchors.anchor: One of his last nights in the hospital.
I put the phone up to his ear. He shut his eyes.

relationships.text: Kurt 是出席 memorial 的 Mark 旧情人之一（Leon 让 Renata 去看他的展）；房东数月来想驱逐他，他偏不走——整层租金约五十块，还在公寓办展，每周六办 Fire Sale。

anchors.anchor: had been trying to evict him for months
Every Saturday, he hosted what he called a Fire Sale

anchors.anchor: an old woman. Her family had abandoned her, too.
